verdict.rationale: License and public-code matching references are a fair axis for an AI coding assistant, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Aider detecting or surfacing license or public-code matches for suggested code. The '(aider)' git author tagging and commit history only attribute authorship and enable review; they are adjacent features, not code-matching references.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
